title: M (GFF)
synopsis: Berlin, 1931. A city gripped by fear: a child murderer is at large, and the police are closing in — but so is the criminal underworld, whose trade is disrupted by the relentless manhunt. When Hans Beckert is finally cornered, he faces not a court of law but a kangaroo trial in a basement, forced to plead for his life before the very men society has condemned.  Fritz Lang's debut sound film remains a masterwork of moral complexity. Drawing on the real-life case of Peter Kürten, Lang wields silence, shadow and Edvard Grieg's haunting leitmotif to ask an unsettling question: who has the right to judge?

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 德國影壇表現主義巨匠 Fritz Lang 在影史上一直被視為美國犯罪類型片祖師，他的第二部有聲電影《M》貫徹他的暗黑風格，改編真人真事，刻劃專門謀殺小女孩的連環殺人狂與犯罪集團及警察之間的亡命追逐，黑幫組織因全城警察頻繁出動搜捕兇手以致生意大受影響，因而透過乞丐網絡率先捉到兇手，並私設法庭對他作出審訊。電影以聲音營造懸疑氣氛，故事深刻探討社會心理與司法正義，奠定了現代心理懸疑與連環殺手電影的敘事基礎。成就影壇永恆經典。
